text:
lisa: Starting staged rollout v2.4 -> v2.5, initial shift 5% at 19:00 PT. release notes: small batching/netty fix + quantization tweak.
deploy-bot: deploy started: `shift traffic 5% to v2.5` — canary window open. monitoring links: https://dash/release/1794443210 :rocket:
mat t: saw the deploybot — good. i’ll watch latency.
sre-june: quick heads-up: alerting configured for 5xx > 0.5% and p95 latency +40ms.
ops-ryan: oncall is here. will jump on pager if anything.
kim: small ping — what’s the rollback plan if quality drops? pin back to v2.4?
lisa: yes, plan A = pin-route to v2.4 (manual) and then rollback job `rollback-service --to v2.4 --forced` if we cross thresholds.
deploy-bot: telemetry: canary metrics at t+6m: error_rate=0.28%, p95=+12ms, embed-similarity-delta= -0.002. no alarms yet.
mat t: :eyes: looks fine so far. hold for 10m then bump to 20% if stable.
sre-june: now seeing a small error slope on a subset of edge nodes (us-west-2 edgepool-b). errors concentrated on Streaming endpoint (502). collecting logs.
ops-ryan: sharing logs in thread: `edgepool-b: 502 xfer timeout` — could be transient. i vote observe for +5m.
kim: i’m leaning hold. recent canaries have had latent 502 spikes and they sometimes lead to client retries. can we pin if it stays >0.4%?
lisa: agree. propose temp hold at 5% and open a safety-pin vote: if rolling 5xx > 0.4% for 3 consecutive minutes, we pin and rollback.
sre-june: ack. i’ll surface tail errors and do a quick correlation with kvcache oom metric.
deploy-bot: automated policy check: surgical-threshold not reached. manual quorum required to pin.
mat t: i vote hold & pin if threshold hit. +1
kim: +1 to hold and pin threshold.
ops-ryan: +1. i’ll prepare rollback runbook and call out infra if we need capacity increase.
lisa: consensus: hold rollout at 5% for now. manual flag `pin=v2.4` ready if rolling error >0.4% for 3m. everyone watch dashboard; if we hit it, call `@deploy-bot pin-route v2.4` and escalate.
deploy-bot: noted. stance: rollout paused at 5%. awaiting signals. reminders: postmortem flag set to `possible-canary-quality-regression` if pin occurs.
sre-june: grabbing logs + stacktraces, will post summary in 10m.
mat t: thanks. if stable at t+15m we can proceed to 20%.
kim: if we proceed later, i want a preemptive note in release notes about the quantization change so CS has context.
lisa: will update release notes with a line about quantization batch sizing and customer impact.
ops-ryan: prepping `rollback-runbook.md` snippet in ops-runbooks. will paste link if we pin.
mat t: one last thing — remember to tag the canary test promptset used for quality checks so we can compare later.
deploy-bot: canary snapshot saved: `canary-1794443210-v2.5` — telemetry continue.
